anyOf.title: Pre-defined configurations
enum: DDDSUUDDDD (5ms,   7DL/2UL), S-slot=6DL:4GP:4UL, same ratios as default
DDDSUUUUDD (5ms,   5DL/4UL), S-slot=6DL:4GP:4UL, balanced downlink and uplink
DDSUUUUUUU (5ms,   2DL/7UL), S-slot=6DL:4GP:4UL, EXPERIMENTAL very high uplink
DDDSU      (2.5ms, 2DL/2UL), S-slot=6DL:4GP:4UL, reduced latency, balanced downlink and uplink
DSUUU      (2.5ms, 1DL/3UL), S-slot=6DL:2GP:4UL, reduced latency, high uplink, no TRS
DSUUU      (2.5ms, 1DL/3UL), S-slot=9DL:4GP:1UL, reduced latency, high uplink
DS         (1ms, 1DL/0UL), S-slot=0DL:2GP:12UL, minimum latency, balanced downlink and uplink, no TRS

pattern1.title: First TDD Pattern
pattern1.description: Definition of the first TDD pattern.

pattern2.title: Second TDD Pattern (optional)
pattern2.description: Definition of the second TDD pattern.

dl_nr_arfcn.title: DL NR ARFCN
dl_nr_arfcn.description: Downlink NR Absolute Radio Frequency Channel Number of the cell

ul_nr_arfcn.title: UL NR ARFCN
ul_nr_arfcn.description: Uplink NR Absolute Radio Frequency Channel Number of the cell. By default a frequency corresponding to dl_nr_arfcn and nr_band is chosen.

ssb_nr_arfcn.title: SSB NR ARFCN
ssb_nr_arfcn.description: SSB NR Absolute Radio Frequency Channel Number of the cell. If set it must be an element of global synchronization raster and be at offset from center DL frequency that aligns with SSB subcarrier spacing of selected band. By default a valid frequency nearby dl_nr_arfcn is chosen.

ssb_pos_bitmap.title: SSB Position Bitmap
ssb_pos_bitmap.description: SSB position bitmap in bits (4, 8 or 64 bits depending on the DL frequency).

root_sequence_index.description: Range 0 to 837 for PRACH format up to 3, 0 to 137 otherwise. prach-RootSequenceIndex parameter. It must be different for each neighbour cell operating on the same frequency and sharing the same PRACH configuration.

enable_sib2.title: Enable SIB2
enable_sib2.description: By default only SIB1 is transmitted. You should enable SIB2 transmission if you have configured any parameters located in SIB2 (example: cell reselection priority) else they will have no effect

prach_config_index.description: Expert only: Integer (range 0 to 262). prach-ConfigurationIndex parameter. Default value depends on TDD configuration

msg1_frequency_start.title: PRACH msg1 Frequency Start
msg1_frequency_start.description: msg1-FrequencyStart parameter. The special value -1 indicates to automatically select the PRACH frequency

pusch_mapping_type.title: PUSCH Mapping type
pusch_mapping_type.description: Select the mapping type for the full UL slots

p_max.description: Range -30 to 33 or -127. p-NR-FR1 (in PhysicalCellGroupConfig IE) and p-Max (in FrequencyInfoUL and FrequencyInfoUL-SIB IEs) value in dB. The value -127 means that the parameter is not broadcast. p-MAX will limit UE Power. By default it is not set so that UE power is not limited

delta_rx_lev_min.description: Value of SIB1.cellSelectionInfo.q-RxLevMinOffset. The value 0 disables the field

uss.title: Expert only: PDCCH UE Search Space
uss.description: Expert only: PDCCH UE dedicated search space configuration defined in RRC PDCCH-Config. Default value depends on TDD configuration, see generated configuration file in Monitor App as a reference

n_candidates.title: Number of Candidates List
n_candidates.description: Mandatory for the DL BWP #0. nrofCandidates parameters for each aggregation level (1, 2, 4, 8, 16).

n_candidates_1.title: Number of Candidates for aggregation level 1

n_candidates_2.title: Number of Candidates for aggregation level 2

n_candidates_4.title: Number of Candidates for aggregation level 4

n_candidates_8.title: Number of Candidates for aggregation level 8

n_candidates_16.title: Number of Candidates for aggregation level 16

dci_0_1_and_1_1.title: DCI 0_1 and DCI 1_1
dci_0_1_and_1_1.description: It defines whether DCI 0_1 and 1_1 are used for PDCCH in the search space. It is relevant only if css is false.

sr_period.title: Scheduling Request Period
sr_period.description: Scheduling Request periodicity. 0 means no Sheduling Request configuration.

k_min.title: Minimum k value
k_min.description: Minimum value for PDSCH k1 and PUSCH k2 and msg3_k2 (range: 1 to 16)

rx_to_tx_latency.title: RX to TX Latency
rx_to_tx_latency.description: Minimum allowed latency in slots between RX and TX. Its range is from 2 slots to 4ms (The default value depends on subcarrier spacing). If the latency is too high, the gNB scheduler may not be able to use all the PDSCH transmission occasions with subcarrier spacings larger or equal to 30 kHz. Increasing the value will improve performances, especially in case of radio frontend underflows. If LTE and NB-IoT cells are present on the RF port, only 4ms is allowed.

trs_presence.title: Expert only: TRS Presence
trs_presence.description: Expert only: Add NZP CSI-RS resources for TRS.

csi_srs_period.title: Expert only: CSI SRS Period
csi_srs_period.description: Expert only: Period for NZP CSI-RS resources, in slots.

subcarrier_spacing.title: Expert only: Subcarrier Spacing (in kHz)
subcarrier_spacing.description: Expert only: Subcarrier spacing in kHz for the data. Currently the same subcarrier spacing is used for downlink and uplink. Note that 60 Khz is not supported for NR SA cells operating in FR1. By default Subcarrier Spacing is 15 kHz for FDD and 30 kHz for TDD.

cipher_algo_pref.title: Preferred Cipher algorithms
cipher_algo_pref.decription: Set the preferred algorithms for RRC and User Plane encryption in decreasing order of preference. If none match the UE capabilities, then NEA0 (no encryption) is selected

integ_algo_pref.title: Preferred Integrity algorithms
integ_algo_pref.decription: Set the preferred algorithms for RRC integrity (and optionally User Plane integrity) check in decreasing order of preference. If none match the UE capabilities, then NIA0 (no integrity check) is selected. (Default: NIA2, NIA1)

l_crb.title: Configured Grant RB Number
l_crb.description: Configured Grant size in number of RBs. Must be a multiple of the RBG size if ra_type is set to type0

periodicity.description: Periodicity of the CG in slots

configuration_type.description: Configuration type1 is a semi-static grant configured via RRC while type2 is activated/released by an UL DCI. type2_immediate will send an activation DCI right after RRC configuration. type2_dynamic will send activation/release DCI based on the UL traffic on the bearers flagged with need_sps.

redcap_ue.title: Reduced Capability parameters
redcap_ue.description: Configure the cell to allow the connection of Reduced Capability UEs (RedCap) and enhanced Reduced Capability UEs (eRedCap).

allow.title: Allow RedCap UEs
allow.description: Defines if RedCap UEs are allowed in the cell or not.

allow_1rx_ue.title: Allow RedCap 1Rx UEs
allow_1rx_ue.description: Defines if RedCap 1Rx UEs are allowed in the cell or not.

allow_2rx_ue.title: Allow RedCap 2Rx UEs
allow_2rx_ue.description: Defines if RedCap 2Rx UEs are allowed in the cell or not.

allow.title: Allow eRedCap UEs
allow.description: Defines if eRedCap UEs are allowed in the cell or not.

allow_1rx_ue.title: Allow eRedCap 1Rx UEs
allow_1rx_ue.description: Defines if eRedCap 1Rx UEs are allowed in the cell or not.

allow_2rx_ue.title: Allow eRedCap 2Rx UEs
allow_2rx_ue.description: Defines if eRedCap 2Rx UEs are allowed in the cell or not.

enable.title: Enable Half Duplex
enable.description: Defines if half duplex support is activated in the cell. For each BWPs where half duplex is enabled, the DCI format 0_1/1_1 will be larger.

tac.title: Tracking Area Code
tac.description: Tracking Area Code (range: 0x0001 to 0xffffff except 0xfffffe, format: integer or hexadecimal starting by 0x)

dl_symbols.title: Downlink Symbols
dl_symbols.description: Number of downlink symbols after the last complete downlink slot.

ul_symbols.title: Uplink Symbols
ul_symbols.description: Number of uplink symbols before the first complete uplink slot.
